description: This file defines a Perl module package 'Git::Packet' that provides functions for reading, writing, comparing, and managing packet-based communication, likely in a Git protocol context. It includes packet read/write operations for binary and text formats, capability negotiation, and initialization routines.

methods.name: packet_compare_lists
methods.description: Compares two lists for equality element-wise, returns 1 if they are identical, otherwise undef.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN based on a 4-hex-character size header, returns a status and data.

methods.name: remove_final_lf_or_die
methods.description: Removes a trailing LF from a buffer string or dies if not terminated properly.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet from STDIN, handling binary and text modes appropriately.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a key=value text packet and verifies that the key matches the expected key.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT with a 4-hex-character size header.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet to STDOUT with a trailing LF.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes the packet stream with a zero-length packet.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Performs protocol initialization and handshake, validating start markers and version.

methods.name: packet_read_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities from the other side until EOF.

methods.name: packet_read_and_check_capabilities
methods.description: Reads remote capabilities and checks for required ones, raising if missing.

methods.name: packet_check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Verifies local capabilities against remote and advertises capabilities.
